MVCTID.description: Moving Load Analysis Control Data - India (MVCTID). Controls how moving-load (IRC/India) analysis results are generated: influence-point generation, plate/frame result positions and stress checks, per-result calculation filters (reactions/displacements/forces/links) optionally restricted to a group, railway bridge tracks, and longitudinal load dispersion.

iIGP.description: Influence generating points mode. 0 = generate by number of points per line element (uses UNUMT); non-zero = generate by fixed distance between points (uses DIST).

UNUMT.description: [iIGP=0] Number of influence generating points per line element.

PLATE.description: Analysis result position for plate elements. Case-insensitive.

FRAME.description: Analysis result type for frame (beam) elements. Case-insensitive.

bRGP.description: Reaction filter scope: false = All, true = restrict to the group named in RGP.

RGP.description: [bREAC=true and bRGP=true] Structure group name to restrict reaction calculation to; must be an existing group. Empty string otherwise.

bDGP.description: Displacement filter scope: false = All, true = restrict to the group named in DGP.

DGP.description: [bDISP=true and bDGP=true] Structure group name to restrict displacement calculation to; must be an existing group. Empty string otherwise.

bFGP.description: Force/moment filter scope: false = All, true = restrict to the group named in FGP.

FGP.description: [bFM=true and bFGP=true] Structure group name to restrict force/moment calculation to; must be an existing group. Empty string otherwise.

bLG.description: Link filter scope: false = All, true = restrict to the boundary group named in LGP.

LGP.description: [bL=true and bLG=true] Boundary group name to restrict link calculation to; must be an existing boundary group. Empty string otherwise.

BRIDGE.description: Bridge type used for impact / CDA (dynamic amplification) calculation.

TRACKS.description: Number of tracks for railway bridge information.

WIDTHTYPE.description: Sleeper width type for longitudinal load dispersion.

WIDTH.description: Sleeper width value for longitudinal load dispersion.

DEPTH.description: Depth of fill (d) for longitudinal load dispersion.
